title: Jab Alexander Ne Porus Ke Hathi Dekhe: The Jhelum Battle Trick
style: energetic, witty Indian podcast storyteller, sharp Hinglish conversational pacing, confident natural cadence, crisp studio mic presence

beats.text: 326 BC mein Alexander poori duniya jeet kar India ke border par pahuncha.
Par saamne khada tha King Porus aur uske do sau vishalkay war elephants!
Greeks ke ghode in hathiyon ki smell aur dahad se hi pagal hokar bhaagne lage.
Toh Alexander ne lagaya ek masterstroke mind game.
Roz raat ko woh shore machakar Porus ko thakaata raha,
aur ek toofani raat mein satrah mile door jaakar Jhelum river chupke se paar kar li.
Phir Greek archers ne hathiyon ki aankhon aur mahouts par teer barsa diye.
Ghayal hokar wahi hathi piche mudkar Porus ki apni hi army ko kuchalne lage!
Porus haar kar bhi jita, aur Alexander ki army ne aage badhne se haath khade kar diye.
